description: Defines the AudioRendererSinkImpl class implementing audio sink functionality for the starboard player filter, including methods for starting, stopping, volume control, and sink support checks.

classes.name: AudioRendererSinkImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AudioRendererSink interface for audio rendering in the starboard player filter.

methods.name: IsAudioSampleTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given audio sample type is supported.

methods.name: IsAudioFrameStorageTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given audio frame storage type is supported.

methods.name: GetNearestSupportedSampleFrequency
methods.description: Returns the nearest supported sample frequency.

methods.name: HasStarted
methods.description: Returns whether the sink has started.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts audio rendering with specified parameters.

methods.name: UpdateSourceStatusFunc
methods.description: Static callback to update source status.

methods.name: ConsumeFramesFunc
methods.description: Static callback for consuming audio frames.
